Schema: public
Name: edb_password_verify
Result data type: boolean
Argument data types: p_username text, p_password text, p_old_password text
Type: func
Volatility: volatile
Parallel: unsafe
Owner: enterprisedb
Security: invoker
Language: plpgsql
Source code:
BEGIN
    -- 1. 최소 길이 체크 (8자 미만)
    IF length(p_password) < 8 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Password is too short (minimum 8 characters)';
    END IF;
    -- 2. 사용자 ID와 동일한지 체크
    IF p_password = p_username THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Password cannot be the same as the username';
    END IF;
    
    -- 3. (선택사항) 이전 비밀번호와 동일한지 체크는 EDB가 PASSWORD_REUSE 옵션으로 알아서 하므로 여기서 굳이 안 해도 됩니다.
    RETURN true; -- 통과 시 true 반환
END;

Schema: demo_cron
Name: pr_generate_random_sample
Result data type: 
Argument data types: IN p_target_kb numeric DEFAULT 1024, IN p_batch_tag character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying
Type: proc
Volatility: volatile
Parallel: unsafe
Owner: dsadmin
Security: definer
Language: edbspl
Source code:
DECLARE
  v_rows NUMBER;
  v_batch_id BIGINT;
  v_tag VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
  v_rows := GREATEST(CEIL(p_target_kb / 8), 1); -- row당 약 8KB 기준
  v_tag := NVL(p_batch_tag, 'cron_' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'));
  INSERT INTO demo_cron.batch_history(batch_tag, requested_kb, generated_rows, created_at)
  VALUES (v_tag, p_target_kb, v_rows, SYSDATE)
  RETURNING batch_id INTO v_batch_id;
  INSERT INTO demo_cron.txn_events(batch_id, event_type, amount, status, event_time, event_note)
  SELECT v_batch_id,
         CASE MOD(gs, 3)
           WHEN 0 THEN 'PAYMENT'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'REFUND'
           ELSE 'ADJUST'
         END,
         ROUND((RANDOM() * 10000)::NUMERIC, 2),
         CASE MOD(gs, 4)
           WHEN 0 THEN 'OK'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING'
           WHEN 2 THEN 'FAILED'
           ELSE 'RETRY'
         END,
         SYSDATE,
         demo_cron.fn_random_clob(1)
    FROM generate_series(1, v_rows) gs;
  INSERT INTO demo_cron.sensor_metrics(batch_id, device_code, temperature, humidity, metric_time)
  SELECT v_batch_id,
         'DEV-' || LPAD(gs::TEXT, 6, '0'),
         ROUND((RANDOM() * 50)::NUMERIC, 2),
         ROUND((RANDOM() * 100)::NUMERIC, 2),
         SYSDATE
    FROM generate_series(1, v_rows) gs;
  INSERT INTO demo_cron.payload_store(batch_id, payload_key, payload_text, payload_bin, created_at)
  SELECT v_batch_id,
         v_tag || '_payload_' || gs::TEXT,
         demo_cron.fn_random_clob(6),
         CONVERT_TO(demo_cron.fn_random_clob(2)::TEXT, 'UTF8'),
         SYSDATE
    FROM generate_series(1, v_rows) gs
  ON CONFLICT (payload_key) DO NOTHING;
END;
